messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

1) **Your email address** (preferred)  
2) The **order id** for the bicycle (it looks like `#W0000000`)

Once I verify your account and see the order status, I’ll help you start the return/refund process.
I’m sorry, but I don’t remember the email address I used for the order. Is there another way you can look up my account? I can provide my name, address, or any other details you need.

Yes—if you can’t share the email, I can look up your account using **name + zip code**.

Please provide:
1) **First name**
2) **Last name**
3) **ZIP code**  
(Just the 5-digit ZIP is fine.)

Once I verify your account, tell me the **order id** for the bicycle (if you have it).
